extDescription.message: Show the current page inside a phone, handheld or laptop frame for demos, screenshots and recordings.

actionTitle.message: Open this page in a device frame

cmdToggleToolbar.message: Show/hide the control bar in the device frame window

cmdCopyScreenshot.message: Copy a screenshot of the device to the clipboard (no download)

cmdRecord.message: Start/stop recording the device to MP4 (no share prompt)

tipNoStatus.message: No status bar on this device

tipSettings.message: Settings: background, frame color, taps, microphone, language

tipRecordShortcut.message: Record the device to MP4 ($1 starts without Chrome's share prompt)

tipShot.message: Screenshot of the device: copy to clipboard and save PNG

tipShotShortcut.message: Screenshot of the device: copy to clipboard and save PNG ($1 copies only)

tipHideShortcut.message: Hide toolbar (or double-click the frame, or $1)

tipSavePreset.message: Save this size as a named device in the dropdown

tipFitWidth.message: Shrink pages that are wider than the device screen so they fit without scrolling sideways (this window only)

tipOpenHidden.message: Every new frame window starts with this toolbar hidden (show it with a double-click on the frame or the tab at the top)

tipOpenHiddenShortcut.message: Every new frame window starts with this toolbar hidden (show it with a double-click on the frame, $1, or the tab at the top)

recWinPicking.message: Choose the screen to record in Chrome's window.

recWinRecording.message: Recording the screen. Keep this window open; it can stay minimized.

msgRecWindowClosed.message: Screen recording stopped: its window was closed

tipModeDevice.message: Record just the device, cropped from this window

tipModeScreen.message: Record everything on one screen, including other windows you switch to (Chrome asks which screen each time)

tipRecScreen.message: Record the entire screen to MP4 (Chrome asks which screen to share)

tipRecScreenShortcut.message: Record the entire screen to MP4 (or $1; Chrome asks which screen to share)

tipStopScreen.message: Stop the screen recording and save MP4

tipStopScreenShortcut.message: Stop the screen recording and save MP4 (or $1, from any window)

tipSystemAudio.message: Sound playing on the computer (videos, alerts), not your voice. When on, Chrome's screen picker offers "Also share system audio"; when off, that option is hidden.

tipCountdown.message: 3 seconds for Device only; 5 seconds for Entire screen, so there's time to hide Chrome's sharing bar

tipRename.message: One rename per line: Old title = New title. Matches the whole title, ignoring capitals; end the old title with * to match titles that start with it. Applies to all tabs, including this window. Saved when you click away.

rulesSkipped.message: Line $1 skipped: use "Old title = New title"

tipIconPick.message: Choose an image (PNG, JPG, SVG or ICO) to show as the icon of renamed tabs

tipIconRemove.message: Go back to each page's own icon

tipIconAlways.message: On: every page in this window shows the tab icon. Off: only tabs renamed by the list above.

msgDeleteAgain.message: Click again to delete this saved device

msgRecStoppedEarly.message: Recording stopped early ($1); saved what was recorded

msgRecSavedWebm.message: Recording saved as WebM (MP4 not supported by this Chrome)

msgCaptureNoStart.message: Can't record: the tab capture didn't start

msgCopiedSaved.message: Copied to clipboard & saved to Downloads
